decisions.reason: Strong public commitment through its own web pages and sunk engineering investment make discontinuation unlikely under escalation of commitment.
As a central floor-level shower system aligned with the firm's announced direction, accumulated investments and public visibility justify continued commitment.
Despite reduced website prominence, prior dedicated-page commitment and design-conscious positioning lead the firm to persist rather than admit failure.
Integrated slope technology is core to installation ease, and even modest initial visibility does not outweigh the resources already committed.
Highly visible launch with quantified claims and homepage placement creates strong escalation pressure to retain this safety-critical product.
Although less central and only mentioned, prior investment and public listing still trigger escalation, though a larger drop probability reflects weaker commitment.
